reviews.t: this is the BEST purchase I have ever made on amazon
reviews.x: this is the BEST purchase I have ever made on amazon. Listen, it smells so good and stays for days! I started off buying the smallest bottle in April and it still isn't finished (August now) and I use it every day twice a day - want to try out the other scents but i am in love with this one! be careful bc it can stain your clothes though, use as oil not perfume although smells stronger than my $80 perfume.

I was skeptical about it at first, considering it isn't the original Lick Me All Over, but I am very glad that I made this purchase!!! You cannot tell the difference between the two!!! It smells exactly the same!! Lasts a long while, and people are always asking me what fragrance I'm wearing!!! One person said I smell good enough to eat!! Nice! I'm definitely gonna be buying more of this!! Thank you!!!

reviews.t: I personally don't like the fragrance
reviews.x: This review is going to be crazy, but here we go.  I personally don't like the fragrance.  To me it smells like a cough syrup.  Here is the crazy thing about this.  People will not stop sniffing me.  Co Workers, students, even my boyfriend keeps saying how they love the new scent.  So since I wear the scents for everyone else...I will buy this again.

I like the sent but this has stained so much of mine. It last long I use it in a spry bottle.  If some lady’s are looking for a nice  Quality fragrance  I  recently heard of this subscription called sent box for 15$ a month you can get  luxury  perfume such as  Gucci, Marc Jacobs,  Prada, ect.

reviews.t: Takes me back to when i went to the carnival as a kid
reviews.x: Lick me all over is a good name for this scent. It has a sweet scent kind of reminiscent of cotton candy. Not as strong as cottin candy though. Its staying power is ok, roughly 8 hours i would say. Could b longer depending on what u do. I like to take a drop and rub my hands together and then rub my hands lightly over my clothes as well. That way if i sweat it off or whatever it's also lightly on my clothes. Its a deep pink, and is a great summer scent. Projection does really well under the summ

It smells nice, really sweet and candyish with a slight sexiness I'd say. Almost a little syrupy smelling, could be overwhelming if you're not careful. I wish it wasn't colored but that's not a deal breaker. Packaging could be better as the lid is sticky from slight leakage when pouring. I know it's cosmetic grade but I also use it in my diffuser and it's nice

I ordered 2oz of "Lick me all over" which i've worn in the past before as a roll on but never ordered online or this amount. Shipping took 5 days but I was in no hurry. Received the oil which I might add was vacuum sealed so it wouldn't splash during shipping.. Brilliant!  Opened for the smell test... AMAZING!  This is the BEST oil version of the scent. It's NOT watered down & strong. You ONLY need a small amount as it packs a Very sweet punch! Absolutely Love and will order again!... Ladies! A

reviews.t: Not what I’m use too but it will do.
reviews.x: This does not smell like the Lick me over that the oil people sale at the mall or at the fair, but it has a pleasant smell very sweet like cotton candy.
This is not authentic lick me all over. This stuff smells terrible.

Exactly what I wanted and the amount was so much more than I expected. It filled up 6 roll-on bottles with plenty to spare. The filled up roll-ons alone would have cost me $5 a piece at my normal oil man. Great purchase!
Was happy with the product,  had been looking for it for about a month , found alot of different versions but this is the one my wife always wears . Thanks.
Smells good but would prefer it thicker. It is a little too watery for my taste.

AMAZING I absolutely love this oil and use it in my diffuser. You can smell the sweetness from the outside of my house! Everyone says how great it smells in my home and it has such a wonderful affect on people. It calms and relaxes, hmmm maybe a bit too much which may be why people don’t want to leave lol...  Also the customer service is awesome. I will be buying more for sure!

reviews.t: I like oils that last all day
reviews.x: Smells ok. I like oils that last all day. This one has trong scent when you 1st put it on. I personally don't think the scent last all day like the baby powder kind does. Note- don't put on the lick me all over and wear light colored or white clothes. The red coloring stains and rubs on your clothes.

reviews.t: Don't buy unless you want to smell like syrup...
reviews.x: I read the reviews and they said it smelled like cough syrup and they are right! Gross!!!
Worse customer service I have ever had in my whole life.. I won't ever purchase again

I think it could have been way bigger but then again a little goes along way so it should last a long time. The scent is amazing it even makes my room smell good in certain area just sitting there in the bottle! It’s worth the buy

reviews.t: Don't buy this product i can walk to the corner and get the same product for less
reviews.x: They make the bottle look taller than it really is and the price is too high for the product.i will never buy again.the smell don't last and it's too watery.

reviews.t: Is nothing like the original lick me all over oil
reviews.x: Does not smell like the original lick me all over oil from the guy at the store close but no cigar disappointed I just wanted to let you guys know
It definitely smells like cough syrup in concentrated amounts but on my skin it smells good. Lasts all day which is what I was really hoping for.
I was lead to believe it was the actual perfume but it is just the oil for making perfume which I do not know how to do.
This smells nothing like lick me all over. It smells like a mixture of bubblegum and carper cleaner
it is supposed to be a mixture of cherry oil and vanilla.  The vanilla was overpowering.
Didn't smell the way I remembered.  Had a type smell.

claims.text: Most reviewers love the scent, describing it as sweet, candy-like, and long-lasting, with many saying it matches the original fragrance.
Several reviewers report that the red coloring stains or rubs off onto clothing.
A few reviewers find the scent unpleasant or not authentic to the original.
Some reviewers note the oil is too watery or thin in consistency.
Reviewers praise the generous amount of product and good value for the price.
